topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and establishes the scope of the material.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the fundamental principles and cellular localization of innate immune recognition using pathogen- and damage-associated molecular patterns.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptor Families and Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the structure, signaling cascades, and effector pathways of specific pattern recognition receptor families and the cytosolic inflammasome.

topics.label: Sentinel Cell Activation and Leukocyte Extravasation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate acute inflammation and guide circulating leukocytes from blood vessels into infected tissues.

topics.label: Antigen Transport and Lymphatic Drainage
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how dendritic cells and lymphatic vessels transport antigens from inflamed tissues to lymph nodes to initiate adaptive immunity.

topics.label: Pathology of Systemic Inflammation and Septic Shock
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the pathological consequences and clinical risks associated with uncontrolled systemic inflammation and septic shock.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Inflammatory Resolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the passive clearance mechanisms and active cellular signals required to terminate the acute inflammatory response.

topics.label: Tissue Repair, Chronic Inflammation, and Granuloma Formation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the mechanisms of tissue healing after injury and the long-term containment strategies that arise during unresolved inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the subject of the upcoming lecture.
